_comment: Journal-sourced apportionment figures, hand-verified from the Río Texas annual journal CF&A reports ('Receipts on all funds for YYYY ... were $X, or Z% of the apportioned amount'). collection_rate is CF&A's stated rate on ALL funds (incl. pension/health/insurance), not the narrower connectional program budget. apportionment_ask is implied = CF&A receipts ÷ rate. Merged into conference-finance.json by scripts/seed_finance.py. ask_source is journal-(year+1).
